items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: Yeah, oh I saw him a couple of years ago.

ctx.x: This is a white guy. Yeah. Was it Black Joe who danced? No, no, he was a white guy. And he's still alive you think.
Yeah, oh I saw him a couple of years ago. And he had his little grandson used to dance every once in a while. But I'm trying to think that pork chops and kidney stew come up there.
They may have, but I associate them with Sharky, but they could have been doing it. They could have been working different places.
